title: Simeon and Anna in the Temple
description: When Jesus is brought to the temple so that his parents may do as the law commanded, the righteous and devout Simeon, whom the Holy Spirit had revealed would not die before he had seen the Lord's Anointed, takes the child in his arms and praises God: "Lord, now you let your servant depart in peace ... my eyes have seen your salvation." He blesses the parents and tells Mary that this child is set for the fall and rising of many in Israel, and that a sword will pierce her own soul. At that same moment comes the prophetess Anna, daughter of Phanuel from the tribe of Asher, an elderly widow who serves God with fasting and prayer night and day in the temple. She praises God and speaks about the child to all who were waiting for the redemption of Jerusalem.

versions.title: Simeon and Anna in the Temple
versions.description: When Jesus is brought into the temple according to the law, the old and righteous Simeon takes him in his arms and praises God: "Lord, now you let your servant depart in peace ... my eyes have seen your salvation." He blesses the family and tells Mary that a sword will also pierce her soul. The prophetess Anna, an elderly widow who serves God with fasting and prayer in the temple, arrives at that very moment, praises God, and speaks about the child to all who were waiting for Jerusalem's redemption.
